BiblicalUsage: Nabach means to bark like a dog, and its only occurrence is a rebuke of watchmen who will not bark. In Isaiah 56:10 the watchmen are blind and ignorant, dumb dogs that cannot bark, sleeping and loving to slumber while danger comes.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a watchman who will not bark is worse than no watchman at all; silence looks peaceful until the enemy is inside the gate.
